description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant in North Vancouver on Saint Johns Street, offering burgers, breakfast items, McCafé beverages, and drive-through service. As a full-service quick-service restaurant with seating, it is a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the area. The location is part of the Canadian McDonald's chain and participates in the MyMcDonald's Rewards app program.

address.value: 3033 Saint Johns Street, North Vancouver, BC
